text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Misato and {0} have
made their way to the Elven Forest for a picnic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はミサトと一緒に
エルフの森へピクニックにやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
Perfect weather for a picnic, isn't it? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
いいお天気♪
今日は絶好のピクニック日和ね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: And being able to relax together like this is nice, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: たまには二人でゆっくりするのもいいわよね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh. That reminds me.
I made some food for you today. Think of it as my way of
saying thanks for everything you've done for me recently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そうそう、
最近{0}君にはお世話になってたし、
そのお礼もかねて今日はお弁当を作ってきたの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully you'll like it...
This spot should do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お口に合うといいんだけど……
うん、
この辺にしましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Do you recognize this place?
It's where we first met.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……
ここ、
覚えてる？
先生とあなたがはじめて会った場所。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Back when you took a big mouthful of a poisonous mushroom.
That brings back lots of memories.
choice_data_list: Thanks for your help back then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
毒キノコを食べて倒れているあなたを
私が見つけたのよね……
懐かしいわねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Not at all, not at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
どういたしましてー

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: It certainly left your entire body numb, at the very least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよねぇ、
痺れて動けなくなっていたものね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
You have no idea how worried I was that day.
I don't want to see you eating anything
off the ground again, you hear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に心配したのよ～
もう拾い食いなんてしたらダメですからね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Let's get started, otherwise you might go
searching for some mushrooms again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ♪　
さ、
お腹が空いてまたキノコを食べちゃわないように、
お弁当にしましょうね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I put in plenty of things you like,
so no need to hold back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君の好きなものいっぱい入れたから、
たくさん食べてねー

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hands together, now.
May we give thanks for—
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
それじゃあ手と手を合わせて、
いっただっきま――

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my! That was quite the surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
魔物ちゃんが……！
先生、びっくりしちゃったわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hm? It's quite the tame one.
Is something wrong with it, maybe?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
随分おとなしい子ねぇ……
どうしたのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's not good. Let's share some of our food with it.
Here you go. Eat up, my little friend. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら……
それじゃあ、お弁当を少しわけてあげましょう。
はいどうぞ、
めしあがれ♪

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Groar! Groar!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――ガウッ！　ガウッ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It sure seems to be enjoying it.
It must have been really hungry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
おいしそうに食べてるわ～
　
本当にお腹が空いていたのねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my. Hehe. What is it?
Do you want me to pet you?
Awww. You're such a little cutie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
うふふふ。
なぁに？　
なでなでして欲しいのかな？
可愛い子ねぇ。
よしよし……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Grohhh...
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グォォォ……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Are you satisfied?
Hehe. Take care, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
もういいのー？
うふふ、
気を付けて帰るのよ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I have to say, I'm surprised you noticed it was hungry.
Very impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
お腹が空いているってよくわかったわねぇ。
すごいわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You learned how to pick up on
what other people want after spending time with me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
先生と一緒にいるうちに、
他の人が何を望んでいるか、
わかるようになったの？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my.
I just let my desire to help others
take control and act from there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
先生はただ、
この子のためになにかしてあげたいって、
そういう気持ちで接しているだけよ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now you've got me all embarrassed, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
なんだか照れちゃうわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's get back to eating.
Hands together, now.
May we give thanks for this delicious food.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
気を取り直してお弁当にしましょうね。
手と手を合わせて、
いっただっきまーす。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. Say \"ahh.\"
Hehe. How is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
あーん……
ふふ、
おいしい？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: That's a relief. There's still plenty left.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お口に合ってよかったわぁ。
まだまだありますからね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget to eat your greens, too.
Hehe. Now that's a good boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お野菜もちゃんと食べましょうねぇ。
うふふ、
えらいえらい。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. You've got some on your face.
I'll eat that right up. Hehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
おべんとうさんついちゃってるわぁ。
ふふ、
先生が食べちゃいましょ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
You wolfed that down, didn't you?
That appetite of yours never ceases to impress me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさん食べたわね～
やっぱり食べ盛りは違うわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Thank you. ♪
My, my. That was quite the big yawn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
おそまつさまでした♪
あら？　
どうしたのあくびして？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I bet you're tired after gobbling all that up, aren't you?
Hehe. Relaxing is our main goal today, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
いっぱい食べたからおねむさんなのかな？
いいのよー、
今日はゆっくりする日なんだから……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: My lap's ready anytime you are. Don't be shy, now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぉら、
先生のお膝においで？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
There we go. Good night, and sleep tight.
I'll keep a firm eye on you while you sleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁい、
よしよし……
おやすみなさいね～
先生が見ていてあげますからね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That was quick.
He's so cute when he's asleep, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
もう寝ちゃってる……
可愛い寝顔ねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
He really has come so far.
Not that he wasn't kind before,
but today and other recent events make it more than apparent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当に成長したわね。
さっきのことも、
この間のことも。
出会った時から優しい子だったけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Now he's as reliable as they come.
text_block_list.orig_text: とっても頼りになる男の子になって……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Enough so that he probably doesn't need me anymore.
Hehe. The thought's leaving me a bit blue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
先生がいなくても大丈夫かしら。
……うふふ、
なんだかちょっぴり寂しいわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's time to let him go...
Or so I say, but he's already become self-dependent.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子離れしないとかしら……
ううん。
もう子どもじゃないわよね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You know, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……先生ね、
あなたのこと……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Silly me.
This isn't the sort of thing I should be
saying when he's still asleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いけないわ、
私ってば……
彼が寝てるときに……
こういうことは、
ちゃんと起きているときに伝えるものよね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus the two of them enjoyed a quiet day together,
soothed by the silence of the forest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
微笑むミサトとその膝でまどろむ{0}を
心地よい森の静けさが包み込んでいた。
